headline: Infineon seeks a Senior Staff engineer for AI-based SV-RNM and automotive AMS verification
fact: Infineon's Bengaluru Senior Staff Engineer Analog Mixed-Signal Verification posting assigns AI-based SystemVerilog real-number behavioral models with speed/accuracy tradeoffs for pre-silicon verification. The role leads automotive subsystem and analog-on-top full-chip verification, develops AMS plans, SPICE-netlist integration, checkers, assertions and coverage, and models bandgaps, LDOs and buck-boost regulators. This is an advertised development and methodology-leadership mandate; the posting does not disclose an AI algorithm, model-generation results or production adoption.

sources.title: Infineon Careers: Senior Staff Engineer Analog Mixed-Signal Verification
